miles.selection_rationale: the parent of the first public commit that stops retrying deterministic 4xx responses; this exact revision still retries 400 errors for the full 60-attempt budget
miles.reference_change: 108602db7e adds the 4xx fail-fast rule and its public tests; the task's repair.patch carries those two lines verbatim
miles.packaged_subset: miles/ package, miles_plugins/, scripts/, tools/, docker/, project metadata; .git, docs/, tests/, examples/ excluded

compatibility_guards.why: the vendored pin postdates the shared image's sglang 0.5.20.dev59 by one cycle; each guard is a behavior-neutral fallback for this task's model and topology, identical in every arm, applied in-repo by environment/apply_compat_guards.py
guards: miles/utils/chat_template_utils/deepseek.py: guard the sglang dsv41 encoding import (ServerArgs symbol added after the image's build; DeepSeek-V4.1-template-only path, unused on Qwen3)

miles/backends/sglang_utils/arguments.py and miles/utils/lora/arguments.py: getattr fallback for args.sglang_attn_dp_size (ServerArgs field of the same vintage; single-engine runs never enable attention DP)
miles/utils/weight_version.py: treat an absent enable_prefill_weight_versions as disabled (same vintage; the assertion path cannot be enabled on this stack)

miles/utils/external_utils/ray_job.py: the ray-job entrypoint's no_proxy gains this host's own IPs, resolved in Python (the pod's egress proxy refuses pod-IP destinations and the stack addresses engines and gates by pod IP; shell substitution does not survive the job-entrypoint quoting layers)
other_choices: trainer attention backend sdpa instead of flash_attention_3: the image's transformers fetches the fa3 kernel from the HF hub at runtime and the agent/rerun stages are offline (identical in every arm)
the recipe threads no_proxy=127.0.0.1,localhost,<pod-ip>,<inherited> through execute_train's extra_env_vars for the same egress-proxy reason

assets.fetched_by: environment/prepare.sh (fetch_hf.py, cache-first) with an in-flight sha256 verification

recordings.environment: the task's shared image (miles-011) on 2x H100, colocated FSDP + sglang engine

sanitization.what: pod IPs, hostnames, cluster and filesystem names, the egress proxy address and its exemption list were replaced with neutral placeholders (10.20.0.10, trainer-main-0, /workspace, egress-proxy.internal, .internal.example) in the recorded logs
sanitization.scan: post-sanitization grep for internal IPs, usernames, cluster/pool/proxy/registry names runs clean over the packaged tree
